questions.stem: In a series circuit with three resistors, what can be said about the current?

options.text: The current is different through each resistor
The current is the same through all resistors
The current is zero through the middle resistor
The current doubles at each resistor

questions.explanation: In a series circuit, the current is the same at all points because there is only one path for the current to flow through. All charge must pass through every component in sequence.
